To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
automated driving on public roads requires continuous testing and is affected by many foreseeable and unforeseeable situations.
the design, development and testing of automated driving systems are very complex, and require continuous research and development efforts.

automated driving on public roads has to deal with many unforeseeable driving situations, which have to be anticipated by the system and which have to be taken care of by the system in an appropriate manner.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of highly reliable, robust, and secure highly automated driving systems for the public road traffic.
the development of a highly automated driving systems that can be used in everyday life.
the development of a system architecture for highly automated driving and the design of the required key technologies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
highly automated vehicles are not ready for public road operation.
the development of a highly automated driving function is a complex task.
the implementation of highly automated driving functions is a challenging and complex task that requires a high level of system integration, testing, and verification.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
highly automated driving systems require a holistic approach that considers all the different aspects of the development and implementation of such systems.
automated vehicles are not a science fiction anymore.
the system design and the development of the highly automated driving system have to consider the different use cases and the different countries.
The main takeaway from our work is that
automated driving is not a single technology, but a system that is based on many technologies that are integrated and tested together.

the development of highly and fully automated driving systems will require a continuous and systematic testing approach, which has to be adapted to the specific driving task, the environment, and road conditions.
the system design and its implementation have to be adapted to the local conditions and regulations to enable highly automated driving on public roads.
